This is a cumulative activity report on Cambodia, Laos, and Vietnam through June 30, 1954. Contained in the document are political, military, and economic reviews as well as technical programs (health and sanitation, agriculture and natural resources, transportation, communications, power, industry and mining, general and community development, education, public administration, and commercial aid).
